phase: Phase 10: Cryptid, Dead Man's Hand, debug
layout: - Phase 10 moved the Cryptid screen into solitaireplus/games/cryptid/collection_screen.py, Dead Man's Hand into solitaireplus/games/dead_mans_hand/game_screen.py (start_dead_mans_hand, exit_dead_mans_hand), and the F10 debug menu into solitaireplus/debug/menu_screen.py (its debug_open_* actions may be in solitaireplus/debug/actions.py or still in legacy.py). The global F10 hotkey is handled in solitaireplus/app/loop.py (before screen dispatch). Profile text fields: state.profile_name_active, profile_country_active, profile_age_active, profile_hometown_active, profile_bio_active. The old Solitaire F8 instant win now lives in solitaireplus/games/solitaire/screen.py as instant_win_round().

tasks.prompt: Fix B59 (the debug menu's Close button doesn't recapture the mouse in Dead Man's Hand): the global F10 path in app/loop.py calls dead_mans_hand_game.capture_mouse() when returning to DEAD_MANS_HAND, but the debug menu's Close button does not. Share one 'return from the debug menu to the previous screen' function used by both paths. Test: opening the debug menu from Dead Man's Hand and pressing Close recaptures the mouse (like F10 does).

Fix B60 (StopIteration for a Cryptid deck with fewer than 2 creatures): cryptid_creatures.py (games/cryptid/creatures.py) uses next(...) that raises StopIteration when a deck has fewer than 2 creatures. Guard it and show a clear message instead of starting a broken battle. Test: a deck with 0 or 1 creatures does not raise and produces the message.

Fix B61 (Dead Man's Hand enemies can spawn in unreachable spots): dead_mans_hand.py (games/dead_mans_hand/levels.py) picks spawn cells without checking reachability. Flood-fill from the player start and spawn only in reachable floor cells (keep spawns deterministic for a given seed where they were already reachable, if possible). Test: on a map with a sealed-off room, no enemy spawns inside it.

D1 (complete): (1) add a 'Win this Solitaire round' button to the F10 debug menu, enabled only when the menu was opened from the Solitaire table (the previous state is PLAYING); it returns to the table and calls the Solitaire screen module's instant_win_round() (the old F8 code). Match the debug menu's existing button style and layout; a disabled look when not available. (2) Ignore F10 while a text field is active: the profile name/country/age/hometown/bio fields (state.profile_*_active) and any other text entry in the single-player game (search for text-input fields). (3) Confirm none of these remain anywhere in solitaireplus/: Solitaire F7/F8 handling, Hold'em F7/Space/B handling, Score Four F6 handling, the Customize 'DEBUG +100 XP' button (debug_xp_rect) - add a test that greps the source for them (via tests/support/locate.source()). Tests: the button wins the round from PLAYING and is inert otherwise; F10 with an active profile text field leaves the state unchanged.
